Name: Acidity regulator
definition: Alters or controls the acidity or alkalinity of a food.

Name: Anticaking agent
definition: Reduces the tendency of components of food to adhere to one another.

Name: Antifoaming agent
definition: Prevents or reduces foaming.

Name: Antioxidant
definition: Prolongs the shelf-life of foods by protecting against deterioration caused by oxidation.

Name: Bleaching agent
definition: Used to decolourize food (excluding flour treatment).

Name: Bulking agent
definition: Contributes to the bulk of a food without contributing significantly to its available energy value.

Name: Carbonating agent
definition: Used to provide carbonation to a food or beverage.

Name: Carrier
definition: Used to dissolve, dilute, disperse or physically modify a food additive or nutrient without altering its function.

Name: Color
definition: Adds or restores colour in a food.

Name: Color retention agent
definition: Stabilizes, retains or intensifies the colour of a food.

Name: Emulsifier
definition: Forms or maintains a uniform emulsion of two or more phases in a food.

Name: Emulsifying salt
definition: Rearranges proteins in cheese manufacture in order to prevent fat separation.

Name: Firming agent
definition: Makes or keeps tissues of fruits or vegetables firm and crisp, or interacts with gelling agents to produce or strengthen a gel.

Name: Flavor enhancer
definition: Enhances the existing taste and/or odour of a food.

Name: Flour treatment agent
definition: Added to flour or dough to improve its baking quality or colour.

Name: Foaming agent
definition: Makes it possible to form or maintain a uniform dispersion of a gaseous phase in a liquid or solid food.

Name: Gelling agent
definition: Gives a food texture through the formation of a gel.

Name: Glazing agent
definition: Applied to the external surface of a food, imparts a shiny appearance or provides a protective coating.

Name: Humectant
definition: Prevents food from drying out by counteracting the effect of a dry atmosphere.

Name: Packaging gas
definition: Gas, other than air, introduced into a container before, during or after the placing of food.

Name: Preservative
definition: Prolongs the shelf-life of foods by protecting against deterioration caused by microorganisms.

Name: Propellant
definition: Gas, other than air, that expels a food from a container.

Name: Raising agent
definition: Substance or combination of substances that liberate gas and thereby increase the volume of a dough or batter.

Name: Sequestrant
definition: Controls the availability of a cation by forming a chelate or complex.

Name: Stabilizer
definition: Makes it possible to maintain a uniform dispersion of two or more immiscible substances.

Name: Sweetener
definition: Non-sugar substance that imparts a sweet taste to a food.

Name: Thickener
definition: Increases the viscosity of a food.
